findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product and materials passes to the client immediately and permanently without requiring full payment to you first.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment of all compensation due under this Agreement, all right, title and interest in and to the Results and Proceeds and to the Advertising Materials shall become the property of the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a small point to discuss before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership of the work product and materials passes immediately without requiring full payment first, and I propose changing this so that ownership becomes the property of the client upon receipt of full payment of all compensation due under the agreement. Looking forward to your thoughts. Best regards,
